title.narrative: Life Saving Emergency Response to DRC Conflict

description.narrative: 1.1 People affected by the conflict and host communities have access to water and hygiene services. 2.1 People affected by conflict have access to essential household items. 3.1 The most vulnerable conflict affected people have increased awareness, improved access to protection and quality psychosocial and health support service. 4.1 People affected by conflict crisis have improved food security and consumption including host families. 5.1. People affected by conflict have enhanced learning environments and inclusive education for newly arrived learners. 6.1 Women and girls including women and girl survivors of gender-based violence have increased household income and livelihood opportunities. 7.1 Conflicts between host community and refugees are reduced and restoration of hope and dignity is enabled through sports and recreational activities among conflict affected communities. 8.1. People affected by conflicts, internally displaced people have access to information they need to hold from Christian Aid and partners to account, their feedback and complaints are responded timely and dignified manner and feedback is used to learn and to adapt the programme.
